ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; visible white surface area comprises less than 5% of the total fluke region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is primarily a uniform low-intensity dark gray to black. Contiguous high-intensity white mottling and focal speckling are restricted to the distal margins of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 40 degrees, extending significantly into the fluke's vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels forming a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, where the lobes terminate in upward-oriented points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (beige/white) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle clustering on the trailing edge tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity white water droplets and spray patterns are visible against the dark ventral fluke surface.
